author: Kai Moreno
title: Dedicated VPC peering intake
content:
# Purpose
Intake for a Dedicated customer who wants VPC peering or PrivateLink to their pool.

# When to use
Intake for a Dedicated customer who wants VPC peering or PrivateLink to their pool.

# What Support does
P3, Eng Infra. Collect CIDRs, account IDs, and whether they need overlapping-range NAT. Hosted cannot peer. Do not file this as a residency questionnaire.

# Intake
Collect the customer, the project or pool name, the region if they named one, and the outcome they want. Write those on the SUP ticket before you route.

# Priority and routing
P3, Eng Infra. Collect CIDRs, account IDs, and whether they need overlapping-range NAT. Hosted cannot peer. Do not file this as a residency questionnaire. If this page and a more specific SOP both apply, the more specific SOP wins.

# Guardrails
Do not issue credits. Do not disable an org API key from this page. Do not invent a label this page does not name.

# Customer reply
Thanks, we have the request. We will follow the internal playbook for this kind of ticket and update you on the SUP thread.

# Related
Support intake checklist. Severity matrix for anything that is actually down. This page is only for the purpose above.
